name: memory

variables.project_home: where facts about the current project belong instead, as a sentence after the WHEN paragraph's last one (" Anything about this project belongs in its AGENTS.md or the project's decision log, not here."), or empty
variables.targets: the targets this project offers and what each is for
variables.past_work: how past work is found again, in parentheses after the SKIP list (" (session_search finds past work)"), or empty
variables.when_seen: when a saved entry reaches the model's instructions
variables.target_values: the `target` parameter's values and what each holds

action.description: A single change. Omit when using operations.

content.description: add/replace: the entry. For replace, the COMPLETE new entry.

old_text.description: replace/remove: a short unique part of the existing entry, to find it.

operations.description: Several changes, applied together or not at all. Preferred for more than one change, and for making room.

content.description: add/replace: the entry. For replace, the COMPLETE new entry — the whole matched entry is overwritten.

old_text.description: replace/remove: a short unique part of the existing entry, to find it.
